correctness.rationale: All boundaries and quantifiers are handled: complete cycle-power cases are excluded; in the noncomplete case degree equality forces \(n=2(p+1)k+1\). Cyclic gaps count all unordered triangles in each regular candidate graph exactly once after threefold rotation correction. The symbolic deficit simplifies to \(nk(k-1)/2\). For \(k=1\) multiplication by p+1 modulo 2p+3 is a bijection sending precisely missing edges to missing edges. The included independent edge and triangle enumerator checks 48 formula profiles and 3,800 small-order boundary triples; these finite tests are corroboration, not the general proof.

value.rationale: The equation G^p≅complement G generalizes a studied square/cube structural problem. A complete classification for all consecutive-jump cyclic circulants and all \(p\ge2\) is a natural infinite theorem. It shows the sole degree-compatible family still fails from a uniform positive triangle defect whenever \(k\ge2\), while all surviving \(k=1\) cases admit explicit modular isomorphisms. This is a substantive global obstruction rather than a small numerical example or rephrased earlier C7/C9 fact.
